paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
coupling_convention: oscillating deuteron EDM amplitude d_AC in e*cm
notes: First storage-ring search for ALP-induced oscillating EDM using a polarized deuteron beam at COSY (JEDI collaboration). Scan covered spin-precession frequencies 119.997-121.457 kHz, corresponding to ALP masses 0.495-0.502 neV (4.95e-10 to 5.02e-10 eV). No resonance observed; the average 90% CL upper limit is |d^d_AC| < 6.4e-23 e*cm, encoded here as a flat bound over the scanned mass range (actual limit fluctuates point-to-point, with values above ~1e-22 e*cm excluded everywhere in the range). The paper also derives bounds on g_adgamma, the ALP-gluon coupling C_G^d/f_a, and the axion-wind coupling C_d/f_a, but the primary directly measured quantity is the oscillating EDM. Note this is a DEUTERON EDM, not neutron, though AxionEDM is the closest enum.
